SAVED LIFE MEMOS
The 5-year library works offline. Daily Prayer uses a built-in curated prayer library; you can edit and save your own wording for each LIFE MEMO. LIFE MEMO uses photographic backgrounds and an expandable image library. Add many photos from your phone or add a direct image address without downloading the photo first. The selected image is drawn into the banner offline, behind the Scripture text. KJV Scripture text is loaded through the free Bible source when needed and cached on your phone. Continuous mode needs internet for fresh Bible passages. New continuous drafts should be reviewed before public posting.

FREE REAL PHOTO SOURCES

Use real photographic backgrounds from these libraries. You do not have to download every photo to your phone: open a photo, use your browser’s Copy image address option, then paste that address into Add Photo by URL. LIFE MEMO stores added photos in a larger on-device image library.

Unsplash — ChristianUnsplash — ChurchUnsplash — PrayerUnsplash — BibleUnsplash — Mountains & LightPexels — ChurchPexels — PrayerPexels — BiblePexels — Mountains & LightPixabay — ChurchPixabay — PrayerPixabay — BiblePixabay — CrossPixabay — Mountains & Light
For a ministry app, download photos from the source site rather than embedding a whole third-party photo library into the app. Unsplash, Pexels and Pixabay each publish free-use licenses, but depicted people, logos and other third-party rights can still matter.

ADD A REAL PHOTO WITHOUT DOWNLOADING

Option 1 — Copy the image address
Open Unsplash, Pexels or Pixabay → open the photograph → long-press the actual photo → choose Copy image address (wording may vary) → return here → tap Add Photo by URL → paste.
Option 2 — Add many photos from your phone
Tap Add Photos, select several photographs at once, and wait for the import to finish. LIFE MEMO now uses IndexedDB instead of the small localStorage limit.
Important: use the address of the actual image, not the webpage address. If the source blocks direct access, LIFE MEMO will try a safe image proxy automatically.
